entry.title: Updated: dsh-llm-vision-bridge
entry.summary: Native LLM-provider vision bridge: images pasted in the chat are described by a vision model (Qwen3-VL via pi-ai/llama.cpp) and the text description is fed to text-only DeepSeek for the reply — image admission, routing and compaction all run through harness-native mechanisms, with an LRU description cache and 503 retry. Exact install spec: dsh-llm-vision-bridge. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
